blocks.html: Adjacent combustible members entering into a concrete or masonry firewall from opposite sides shall not have less than a 4-inch (101.6 mm) distance between embedded ends. Where combustible members frame into hollow walls or walls of hollow units, hollow spaces shall be solidly filled for the full thickness of the wall and for a distance not less than 4 inches (101.6 mm) above, below and between the structural members, with noncombustible materials approved for fireblocking.
